headline_results: All 12 FENDL-3.2c evaluations ACTINV rejected during the P26b artifact build were classified by file-level forensics: 4 true_defect, 8 actinv_strictness, 0 ambiguous.

true_defect (file contradicts ENDF-6 or itself): Ni62 (Breit-Wigner GT=1.882601 vs component sum 1882.6008 — an exact 1000x keV/eV unit mix), W182 (MF1 AWR 180.3850 vs MF2 AWR 180.3852), W184 (MF1 AWR 182.3710 vs MF2 AWR 182.3700), W186 (MF10 MT16 state sum exceeds its own MF3 total by 5.09e-2 at 8 MeV on the shared energy grid).

actinv_strictness (file is legal ENDF-6; ACTINV demands more than the format): Cr50/52/53/54, Mn55, W180 (MF=10 activation channels shipped without MF=3 totals — products verified physically consistent, e.g., Cr52 MT17=(n,3n) produces Cr-50 at QM=-21.301 MeV), Fe57 and W183 (LRF=7 RML particle pairs using the legal ENDF-6 negative-spin parity encoding, e.g., IB=-0.5).

gates.G0: 12 rejected source files + rejection log sealed (results/g0_p37_seals.json)
gates.G1: every file classified with quoted evidence and named check site (results/g1_p37_classification.json)
gates.G2: independent re-derivation of all grounding facts — 15 controls pass (results/g2_p37_controls.json)
gates.G3: 8 negative controls pass — missing evidence flagged, enum enforced, no overclaim (results/g3_p37_controls.json)
gates.G4: closure checks — disposition scoped, no validation behavior changed

conditions: This is file forensics, not evaluation-author adjudication: 'true_defect' means the file contradicts ENDF-6 semantics or itself at the cited record; whether the error entered at evaluation, processing, or distribution is outside what the artifact alone can prove.

The actinv_strictness class is a deliberate ACTINV contract (conservation anchored to an independent total), not a bug. Relaxing it — e.g., extending the MT18 self-comparator amendment to non-fission MTs — is a separate phase decision with its own protocol; this phase changes nothing.

W182/W184 are borderline: the AWR mismatch is real but tiny (1e-6 relative); a tolerance-based check would also be defensible. They are labeled true_defect because the file literally contradicts itself.

The identical-data arm remains blocked: the 8 strictness files are at most admissible under a future relaxation decision; the 4 true_defect files cannot be admitted by any lawful parser change without an unrecorded modification of the source data — that needs upstream correction or a protocol-governed normalization pass.
No claim follows about ALARA correctness: ALARA accepted the files because its format contract is looser, not because its activation results on them are verified.
No solver, superiority, coverage, release, or validation claim is made or implied.
